note: Measured on Windows 11 26H2 (build 26300), 2560x1600 @150% scaling, release build 0.1.0. WebView2 processes are counted only when they are descendants of the host process; other applications on the machine have their own WebView2 instances and must not be included.
observations: The idle target (<=30 MB) is met with a wide margin: 11.8 MB with zero WebView2 processes, because the floating ball is a native layered window and no webview exists until a window is opened.
The first window costs ~340 MB of WebView2 processes. This is the fixed price of the Chromium engine (browser + GPU + renderer + utility processes) and is not reducible by application code.
Closing a window destroys its webview and releases those processes again (verified by re-running the idle measurement).
